result.title: MaskedVGGT: Masked Multi-View Transformers Are Scalable 3D Learners
result.comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables. Code is available at https://github.com/zzctmd/MaskedVGGT
result.summary: Multi-view feed-forward models show strong scalability, but their reliance on costly geometric annotations limits data scaling. Existing 3D self-supervised approaches reduce this reliance through cross-view completion (e.g., CroCo, MuM, Muskie) or novel-view synthesis (e.g., RayZer, E-RayZer), typically learning image representations and cross-view interactions jointly. We argue that learning single image representations from scratch is unnecessary for 3D pretraining methods, as doing so fails to benefit from the continuing advances in 2D foundation models (e.g., DINO, CLIP, frontier VLMs). We introduce MaskedVGGT, which freezes a strong pretrained 2D encoder and pretrains only an added, randomly initialized multi-view transformer, focusing on learning interactions across views. MaskedVGGT pretrains the multi-view transformer through masked self-distillation without annotations: a student predicts targets at masked locations based on complete anchor views and heavily masked remaining views, while an exponential-moving-average teacher provides prediction targets based on unmasked inputs. In experiments across model sizes up to 1B parameters, MaskedVGGT pretraining followed by fine-tuning outperforms single-stage supervised VGGT-$Ω$ training with the same training data, model architecture, and total number of optimization updates. MaskedVGGT also outperforms E-RayZer, CroCo, MuM, and Muskie, providing evidence for the effectiveness of building multi-view pretraining on strong 2D representations. Finally, extending pretraining with additional unlabeled videos further improves generalization, and the learned representations transfer to diverse downstream tasks. These results demonstrate an effective division of learning: reuse strong image representations from 2D pretraining and learn cross-view interactions from unlabeled multi-view data without relying on geometric annotations.

AI.brief_summary: MaskedVGGT 冻结预训练 2D 编码器，只预训练新增的多视角 Transformer：用完整锚视图加高度遮蔽的其余视图作学生输入，由 EMA 教师基于未遮蔽输入提供目标，做无标注遮蔽自蒸馏；在至多 1B 参数下优于同数据的监督 VGGT-Ω 及 CroCo、MuM、Muskie、E-RayZer。
AI.relevance_reason: 冻结视觉编码器、仅训练跨视图交互模块并以 EMA 教师做遮蔽自蒸馏，可能为「无标注监督 latent 交互状态」及「固定视觉编码器是否导致视觉旁路或信息坍缩」提供可供核查的训练线索，但本文属 3D 几何预训练，与 VLM 推理无直接关联。
